_comment: What a gate SDK does with and without an API key. Run by @intutic/gate (packages/gate-js/src/__tests__/localOnly.test.ts) and intutic-clawde (packages/intutic-clawde/tests/test_gate_local_only.py). A client with no key is local-only: it sends no request at all, its hook gate answers allow with code LOCAL_ONLY whatever failClosed says, and the Gate skips the SOP register, while the local tiers (policy snapshot, SSO groups, MCP registry, image integrity) still decide. A key the control plane refuses (401) is an authentication fault, not 'no credentials', and fails closed. `response` is the control plane's answer to every request it receives. `requests` is the number of requests the control plane must receive; absent, it is not checked. `snapshotRules` are data lines of a verified policy snapshot. `refused` is the refusal code, or null for an allow. `construction` covers a client given no control-plane address (no baseUrl / base_url, INTUTIC_CONTROL_PLANE_URL unset) while the hosted control plane is not released (`cloudReleased` is the CLOUD_RELEASED a vector applies to): with no key it is local-only, with a key the constructor throws, its message containing `messageContains`, rather than skip the hook gate unannounced.

hookGate.name: no key: local-only, no request, allow that says why
no key, failing open: the same answer
a key the control plane refuses (401) fails closed
a key the control plane accepts gets its verdict

guard.name: no key: a shell call the snapshot allows runs, and nothing is sent
snapshotRules: sop.s_write	block		tool	no writes to the ledger	 (Write)

guard.name: no key: the snapshot still refuses
snapshotRules: sop.s_write	block		tool	no writes to the ledger	 (Write)

guard.name: a key the control plane refuses (401): the hook gate fails closed
snapshotRules: sop.s_write	block		tool	no writes to the ledger	 (Write)

construction.name: key, no URL, cloud not released: the constructor throws
